cover_headline: India TB Mortality Falls 38 Percent Since 2015, WHO Report Finds

end.headline: India TB Mortality Falls 38 Percent Since 2015, WHO Report Finds
end.line: India's TB death rate fell to 18 per lakh in 2025, down from 28 per lakh in 2015, with a 94% treatment success rate.

facts: India recorded a 38% decline in tuberculosis mortality since 2015, compared with a global decline of 35%
India's TB mortality rate fell from 28 per lakh in 2015 to 18 per lakh in 2025
Treatment success among patients with drug-susceptible TB was 94%
